keyword: same size number on different concrete pump parts

title.en: When the same number is a different Pinjin spare
title.zh: 同一个数字在品锦是不同配件时

description.en: φ80 is a mixing seal, a main-cylinder seal, a swing-cylinder seal, an S-tube small-end seal and a swing-arm ball. DN80 is a clamp. 80 mm is the Electric 20 pipe cell. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not merge those rows.
description.zh: φ80 是搅拌密封、主油缸密封、摆缸密封、S 管小端密封和摆臂球头。DN80 是管卡。80 mm 是电动20的管子格子。河北品锦机械没有把这些行合并。

h1.en: The same printed number on different spare pages
h1.zh: 不同配件页上的同一个数字

directAnswer.en: A repeated size on the Xingtai wear-part list is not one item. Each product page keeps its own name, unit and, where printed, material. No page assigns the shared number to one pump model.
directAnswer.zh: 邢台易损件清单上重复的尺寸不是一件物品。每张产品页保留自己的名称、单位，以及印出的材料。没有一页把这个共用数字指定给一台泵。

body.en: Mixing seal φ80, set, no material printed. Main-cylinder seal φ80, set. Swing-cylinder seal φ80, set. S-tube small-end seal φ80, set. Swing-arm ball φ80, piece, white or black, upper or lower. Clamp DN80 / 3″ / 89, EN14420-3, PN10/16. Electric 20 delivery pipe inner diameter 80 mm. These seven uses stay on seven pages.
body.zh: 搅拌密封 φ80，套，未印材料。主油缸密封 φ80，套。摆缸密封 φ80，套。S 管小端密封 φ80，套。摆臂球头 φ80，个，白或黑，上或下。管卡 DN80 / 3″ / 89，EN14420-3，PN10/16。电动20输送管内径 80 mm。这七处仍在七张页面上。

body.en: φ60 and φ70 are both a swing-cylinder seal and a swing-arm ball. φ90 is both a swing-cylinder seal and an S-tube small-end seal. φ100 as an S-tube small-end seal is not the pipe cell 100 / 125 mm. Shared piston ODs are listed on the split and integral pages and remain two parts.
body.zh: φ60 和 φ70 同时是摆缸密封和摆臂球头。φ90 同时是摆缸密封和 S 管小端密封。作为 S 管小端密封的 φ100 不是管子格子 100 / 125 mm。两张活塞页上相同的外径仍然是两件配件。

body.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Put the part name before the number. A number alone is not an order line.
body.zh: 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 数字前面写配件名称。只有数字不能作为订货行。

question.en: Can one φ80 order cover every page?
question.zh: 一次 φ80 询价能覆盖每一页吗？

answer.en: No. Name the page: mixing seal, main-cylinder seal, swing-cylinder seal, S-tube small-end seal, or swing-arm ball.
answer.zh: 不能。写明是哪一页：搅拌密封、主油缸密封、摆缸密封、S 管小端密封或摆臂球头。

question.zh: 电动20的 80 mm 是活塞吗？

answer.en: No. It is the delivery-pipe inner diameter cell on that pump page.
answer.zh: 不是。它是该泵页上的输送管内径格。

question.en: Does a shared number assign a pump?
question.zh: 共用数字会指定泵型号吗？

answer.en: This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine.
answer.zh: 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。

answer.en: A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank.
answer.zh: 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。

label.en: Email or WhatsApp the Xingtai factory
label.zh: 邮件或 WhatsApp 联系邢台工厂
